Aviso.SoMestre: Only the GM can use the World Navigator.
Aviso.Offline: {nome} is offline: they will join "{mapa}" directly when they connect.
Aviso.SemModulo: The module did not respond in {nome}'s browser. Ask them to press F5.
Aviso.TodosPreCarregados: All online players have already preloaded this map.
Aviso.SemChegada: {nome} did not confirm arriving on "{mapa}". Ask them to press F5.
Aviso.TransferenciaDesfeita: Couldn't remove {token} from "{origem}". The copy on "{destino}" was undone, and the token is still on "{origem}".
Aviso.TokenDuplicado: {token} is now on two maps: "{origem}" and "{destino}". Couldn't undo the copy; delete one of them by hand.
Aviso.SemCasaLivre: Found no free space near the arrival point on "{mapa}". The token was placed at the arrival point, possibly on top of another one.
Aviso.AreaCheia: Arrival area of "{mapa}" is full: the token was placed on the nearest free space, outside the area.
Aviso.TokenNaoCabe: {token} is larger than the map "{mapa}" and doesn't fit. The token was not moved and stays where it was.

Jog.ModuloSemResposta: The module did not respond in their browser. Ask them to press F5.

Grupo.Vazio: Select players with Ctrl and click "save as group".

Mapa.Buscar: Search map, folder, note or tag...
Mapa.SemMiniatura: No thumbnail — generate it from the ⋮ menu

Pasta.DentroDelaMesma: A folder cannot be placed inside itself.

Etq.DicaFiltro: Click to filter · right-click changes the color

Dica.Geral: Drag a player or a group onto a map (or click it, then click the map). Ctrl selects several; Esc clears. Drag maps onto others to reorder, or onto folders to move them. Double-click a map to view it.

Detalhes.NotaDica: Shown on the map card, only in the GM's window.
Detalhes.MusicaDica: Uses Foundry's native playlists, including those created by Audio Console. "Only whoever enters" plays in the browser of whoever is on the map and stops when they leave.
Detalhes.TelaDica: Blank uses the map name and the default text from the settings. The comment can have more than one line.

Chegada.Clique: Click the map where tokens should arrive. Esc or right-click cancels.

Portal.SemMestre: A GM must be connected to move tokens to another map.
Portal.Erro: Could not move the token to the other map. Check the console (F12).

LembrarLugar.Nome: Players return to their last map
LembrarLugar.Dica: On joining or reloading (F5), the player opens directly on the last map they were on, without loading the active map first. Exception: "Activate map" takes the whole table, and anyone who was offline joins on the active map.

Transicao.Dica: When the GM sends a player (or they use a portal). "Native" uses Foundry's animation: the map's own (Configure Scene > Transition Animation) or, if the map has none, the one chosen below. If the native one cannot be used, the module's own screen is shown instead. The other options show the module's own screen, with title, comment and loading text.

TransicaoNativaTipo.Dica: Used when the destination map has no transition of its own in its configuration.

TransicaoNativaDuracao.Dica: Applies to the default transition above. Maps with their own transition use their own duration.

TransicaoTexto.Dica: Text shown at the bottom of the transition screen (blank: "Loading"). Each map can have its own in "Note, tags and music".

TransicaoTempo.Dica: The transition screen stays at least this long, even if the map loads quickly, so the animation plays in full. If the map takes longer, it stays until loading finishes.

OcultarNavMestre.Nome: Hide the scene navigation bar for the GM
OcultarNavMestre.Dica: Hides Foundry's scene navigation for the GM, leaving only the World Navigator button.

OcultarNavJogadores.Nome: Hide the scene navigation bar for players
OcultarNavJogadores.Dica: Players no longer see (or use) scene navigation. Only the GM moves them between maps.

OcultarAbaCenas.Nome: Hide the Scenes tab in the sidebar
OcultarAbaCenas.Dica: Hides the Scenes tab on the right, since the World Navigator does everything it does. Maps are not deleted: turn it off to bring the tab back.

AreaChegada.Dica: How many rings of spaces around the arrival flag make up the area where tokens arrive, one token per space, from the center outwards. 0 = only the flag's space (other tokens go to the nearest free spaces). 1 = the flag and the spaces around it (7 hexes or 9 squares). 2 = 19 hexes or 25 squares. When the area is full, the next tokens go to the nearest free space and the GM is warned.

TransicaoPropriaEstilo.Dica: How the new map takes the place of the old one.
TransicaoPropriaEstilo.Veu: Veil (fades into a color and out of it)

TransicaoPropriaCor.Dica: The color of the glow on the edge between the two maps or, with Veil, the color the map fades into.

TransicaoPropriaSuave.Dica: 0 = hard cut between the maps; 100 = very soft.

TransicaoPropriaBrilho.Dica: Strength of the glow, in the chosen color, where the two maps meet (0 turns it off).

Menu.Dica: All World Navigator options, grouped by subject: players, arrival, transition and map bars.

Lema.Geral: Where players enter and where tokens arrive.
Lema.Transicao: What a player sees when sent to another map or going through a portal.
Lema.Interface: What stays hidden on screen, so the Navigator handles maps on its own.

Central.DependeNativa: Applies when the transition type is Foundry's native one.
Central.DependeTela: Does not apply with the transition turned off.
Central.Falhou: Could not save: {lista}. The others were saved. See the console (F12).

Conflito.Texto: These settings were changed in another window while the Hub was open:

NaoSalvo.Texto: There are {n} unsaved change(s). Close anyway?

Central.NotaPropria: It shows as "Custom (Navegador de Mundos)" in Foundry's transition list: pick it in "Default native transition" or in a map's configuration. The duration is the native transition's.
Central.DependeBorda: Does not apply to the Veil style.
Central.TesteSemMapa: Open a map to test the transition.
Central.TesteFalhou: I could not play the test here. Pick the custom transition and send a player to a map to see it; the reason is in the console (F12).
